bosses.name: Anub'Rekhan
bosses.cite: boss_anubrekhan.cpp:44 LOCUSTSWARM 28785 is a 20 s self buff on him (naxxramas.ts:199 schedules it every 90 s); the raid leaves melee range until it drops

encounterRows.label: Leave the Locust Swarm (30 yd)
encounterRows.cite: boss_anubrekhan.cpp:44 SPELL_LOCUSTSWARM 28785 is a 20 s self buff on him (naxxramas.ts:199 schedules it every 90 s) whose proc_trigger fires 28786 every 2 s - aoe radiusYd 30, 875 nature and a 6 s silence, so it is a disc on HIM and not an aura on a raider. 35 is that 30 plus FLEE_CLEAR_MARGIN_YD. keep_range names the entry rather than the focus so a raider on an add still leaves, and its executor already stands the current victim down: nobody out-walks the mob that is on them

bosses.name: Maexxna
bosses.cite: boss_maexxna.cpp:41,47-53 WEB_WRAP_INIT 28617 pins a raider to the wall behind a wrap NPC that has to be killed to free them - the one add whose order matters

blockedBy.kill-order: 28627 Summon Web Wrap DOES resolve summon_wild + cc, so the wrap body exists once something casts it - and nothing does: 28617 resolves script_handled_noop, and naxxramas.ts:378 names the real gap, HandleVictimCheck has the VICTIM cast 28627 and there is no cast-as-player verb. dungeonSpawns map 533 also carries no 17055 Spiderling

bosses.name: Noth the Plaguebringer
bosses.cite: boss_noth.cpp:38-80 the balcony teleport plus CURSE_PLAGUEBRINGER 29213 and Plagued Warriors/Champions. The curse is a decurse call and the adds are unordered, so no kind in this vocabulary applies - naxxramas.ts:84-86 already owns the balcony phase gap

bosses.name: Grand Widow Faerlina
bosses.cite: boss_faerlina.cpp Worshipper 16506 Widow's Embrace 28732; Rain of Fire 28794

mcEntries.cite: boss_faerlina.cpp:47,89-109 28732 is cast onto her by a MIND CONTROLLED Worshipper; naxxramas.ts FAERLINA_ADDS puts 4 of them on the floor

encounterRows.label: Step out of Rain of Fire (10 yd pool)
encounterRows.cite: creature_spell_list 1595301:2 Rain of Fire 28794 bakes aoe ground radiusYd 10 with a 6 s fire dot (tickMs 2000); naxxramas.ts BOSS_FAERLINA schedules it every 16 s on hostile_random_player. isPersistentAreaEffect (aoe+dot) spawns the pool

encounterRows.label: Run the dance - step off the erupting tile
encounterRows.cite: boss_heigan.cpp:92,173-188 StartEruptions and :280-290 PlagueWaveController cycle {30116,30117,30118,30119,30118,30117}; each wave spell's three ACTIVATE_OBJECT slots light a third of its own Plague Fissures through spell_script_target, and every fissure is a gameobject_template type 6 whose trap.spellId is 29371 Eruption (direct_damage nature 3500-4500, radiusYd 6). The pools land at the fissures' own spawns through applySpell's activate_object arm; hazardProximityYd reads their edge the same way Magmadar's Conflagration row does. Driven by src/dev/smoke/heiganDance.mjs: 345 sites over the four waves, 88 live pools on a cast, a raider standing on one takes the hit

bosses.name: Loatheb
bosses.cite: boss_loatheb.cpp Decurse / Corrupted Mind — healer rows after 29201 bake

mcEntries.cite: boss_razuvious.cpp:20,46,72-81 a MCd Understudy taunts him with 29060; naxxramasMilitary.ts:32-34 keeps its baked list 1680305 in play

blockedBy.camp-split: the adds are NOT the gap any more: 28007 / 28009 / 28011 bake proc_trigger and their triggers 27884 / 28008 / 28010 resolve summon_wild, and naxxramasMilitary.ts:198-200 arms all three on the sourced 4 s / 49 s / 104 s clock. What blocks the camps is the side state: boss_gothik.cpp:315 IsInRightSideGothikArea has no representation here (naxxramasMilitary.ts:37-43), so there is no live side and no gate for two camps to split across

encounterRows.cite: naxxramas.h:79 NPC_ZOMBIE_CHOW 16360; boss_gluth.cpp:116-136 SUMMON_ZOMBIE_CHOW 28216 (naxxramasConstruct.ts:178 arms it on Gluth); 28216 resolves proc_trigger 28217 -> summon_wild 16360; :162-182 DEVOUR 28236 finds a 16360 and 28238 heals him 5 %

bosses.name: Kel'Thuzad
bosses.cite: boss_kelthuzad.cpp:92 MANA_DETONATION 27819 makes every mana user its own bomb, and the Shadow Fissure 27810 void zones are the other thing to stand out of

encounterRows.label: Step out of the Shadow Fissure void zone
encounterRows.cite: creature_spell_list 1599001:3 Shadow Fissure 27810 is scheduled on 15990 (targetId 100, 15-25 s) and its rawEffect 41 summons 16129; 16129 carries creatureCasts 27812 scriptId 1612901 eventType 1, so groundAoeOf publishes it. 27812 Void Blast bakes aoe ground radiusYd 5 direct_damage with rawEffects targetA 18 TARGET_LOCATION_CASTER_DEST, so the blast is centred on the fissure and persistentAreaFromSpell returns null (no dot). Measured by src/dev/capabilities/avoidZone.mjs: blastsTaken 0 with the row against blastsWithoutRow 5, ydFromFissure 6. Cite: boss_kelthuzad.cpp:92
encounterRows.note: Detonate Mana 27819 is the OTHER half of this boss's spread and stays unauthorable: it resolves proc_trigger and its baked effects[] are empty, so it puts no aura on the raider for a buffPresent row to gate on.
